主要内容: On February 11, 2015, Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. issued a press release announcing its earnings for the quarter ended December 31, 2014. The earnings release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing. The information provided in the press release is not deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933 or the Exchange Act, except as expressly set forth by specific reference to such filings. The press release details the company's financial results for the quarter, which is a key financial report for investors and stakeholders. The filing is part of the company's compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, and the press release is an important communication tool for the company to share its financial performance with the public.
